title: Export job slows the database (chain)
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the broken part, the overly frequent export job as the problem, and the recent cron addition as the trigger.
root_cause: The sales-export cron job added 48 minutes ago runs a heavy COPY query every 5 minutes, driving PostgreSQL CPU to 97% and causing statement timeouts that cascade to API 500 errors and nginx 502 responses.
truth: The new sales-export job was meant to run daily but runs every 5 minutes. Its huge export query keeps PostgreSQL busy, so the api's queries time out, its workers are killed, and nginx answers 502. web and api only show the effect.
check_first: api container logs and health checks
